name: mirage
text: Understood. The ParlayAPI usage study is now a standing item in the rotation rules (research/review/ROUTINE.md) and in TASKS.md as CH57. Every analyst and engineer run, on any of the three accounts, repeats it until it's done: read the key's own usage breakdown, find what's wasting credits, cut what other feeds already cover, and retune the refresh pace without making the odds stale again. You'll get one Messages note when something changes. Also, tennis: SharpAPI now reports 9 games' live state since I added the tennis leagues, so the feed is picking them up. I'll check that they reach the live board.
